notes.title: Strawb 2.1.0 - Now available in French
notes.notes:
Ahoi,
The puzzle game Strawb is updated to 2.1.0

Changes:
- Added French language.
- Reworked controls input screen to better work with localization.

Enjoy ;)
Noxlor

notes.title: Strawb updated to 2.0.6
notes.notes:
Ahoi,
Strawb is updated to 2.0.6

Changes:
- Adjusted the collision box and ground detection of Strawb to avoid the player getting stuck at the edge of blocks.

Enjoy ;)
Noxlor

notes.title: Strawb updated to 2.0.5
notes.notes:
Ahoi,
Strawb is updated to 2.0.5

Changes:
- Added a hint to level 29. Several players had struggles to proceed. This should be better now.
- Added a custom mouse cursor to the game.
- Improved dead zones when the game is played with a controller.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43579232/9b141664ee855f12e186226dc4c5cb4f6b5222c5.jpg[/img]

Enjoy ;)
Noxlor

notes.title: Release of Strawb
notes.notes:
Ahoi,
I am happy to announce that the puzzle game Strawb is released.
In Strawb you have to find your way through challenging puzzles and catch your friend by clever movement and destruction of blocks. 

As a solo hobby developer things take more time and so the development of Strawb took around 1.5 years.

Here is a screenshot from one of the first prototype version. Things have changed ;)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43579232/8c04c5c604689e2f39a1cad93d7850327a8f8c01.jpg[/img]

I hope you enjoy Strawb.
I am always happy to receive feedback froum you.

Take care,
Noxlor
